title: Momcozy 7-in-1 Baby Bottle Brush Set with Drying Rack, Pink
bullets: 【7-in-1 Best Cleaning Tool】Momcozy baby bottle brush set combines bottle cleaning, drying, and storage in one compact kit. Includes a silicone bottle brush, bottle drying rack, straw cleaner brush, nipple brush, soap dispenser, and a storage box for everyday bottle care.

【Foldable Drying Rack】The built-in rack keeps bottles and pump parts elevated for convenient air-drying after washing. Fold it away when not in use to save countertop space and keep everything organized.

【3 Brushes, More Coverage】Three dedicated brushes handle different cleaning needs. The silicone baby bottle brush cleans bottles and cups, while the nipple and straw brushes reach smaller openings, tight corners, and narrow spaces.

【Easy to Carry】All bottle brush tools store neatly inside the compact case for everyday use at home or on the go. Easy to pack in a mom bag or travel bag for vacations, overnight stays, and visits - and a practical gift for new parents.

【Safe & Durable】Made with soft, durable food-grade silicone and BPA-free materials for everyday baby bottle cleaning. The brush head can also be boiled for sterilization, providing peace of mind for parents.
